origin_boundary: Allowed origins are read from environment. Tests use a non-production placeholder. Cole's QR domain later changes environment only, never code.
acceptance_tests: Separate per-IP and per-session limits hold across processes
Registration and verification endpoints have per-IP limits
Rate-limit state uses a named SQLite table in WAL mode
Authorized preflight succeeds for the configured placeholder origin
Unknown origins receive no CORS permission headers
Credentialed responses never use wildcard origins
Changing the allowed origin requires no code change
